STRIX_TARGET.description: Target for the Strix.ai agent to test. Accepts a URL (https://your-app.com), a git repository (https://github.com/org/repo), or a local path inside the dispatcher container. One target only per scan.

STRIX_LLM.description: LLM identifier the Strix agent should drive. Examples: 'openai/gpt-5.4', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4-6', 'openai/gpt-5.2'. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

STRIX_LLM_API_KEY.description: API key for the LLM provider selected by STRIX_LLM. Sent to the strix CLI as the LLM_API_KEY env var. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value. Do not confuse this with the strix_pat_... token from Strix Cloud — that token is for the dashboard, not the local CLI.

STRIX_SCAN_MODE.description: Scan depth. Default 'quick'. Valid: quick | standard | deep. Deeper modes burn more LLM $ — cap with STRIX_MAX_BUDGET_USD.

STRIX_MAX_BUDGET_USD.description: Hard cap on total LLM spend for the scan (passed to strix --max-budget-usd). Default 5. Once the cap is hit strix terminates cleanly with a 'stopped' status; findings up to that point are still emitted.

STRIX_INSTRUCTION.description: Free-text guidance for the agent — credentials, focus areas, out-of-scope caveats. Passed to strix --instruction.

STRIX_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Subprocess wall-clock timeout in seconds. Default 1800 (30 min).

STRIX_RUNS_DIR.description: Directory strix writes strix_runs/<run>/ into. Default '/tmp'. Override if you want the run artefacts persisted on a mounted volume.

STRIX_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for findings. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

check_cmds: which strix >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'strix CLI not installed — pipx install strix-agent'
name: strix
title: Strix.ai
description: Strix.ai autonomous AI-pentester — CLI wrapper (not a REST importer). Invokes the `strix -n --target <T> --scan-mode <quick|standard|deep>` command against a URL/repo/path, drives an internal LLM sandbox (STRIX_LLM + STRIX_LLM_API_KEY), then parses strix_runs/<run>/{findings.json,results/*.json} for the produced vulns and emits Faraday bulk-create. Each finding lands as one Faraday vulnerability tagged '[AGENT]' on the scan target, with PoC + remediation folded into the description and CVE/CWE cross-refs. A synthetic 'scan summary' vuln is always emitted so an empty scan still records the run in Faraday. Runtime prereqs baked into the dispatcher image: `strix` binary on PATH (installed via pipx install strix-agent) and Docker socket mounted read-write (strix launches a nested Docker sandbox). Scan cost is capped with STRIX_MAX_BUDGET_USD. Exit codes: 0=no vulns, 1=exec error, 2=vulns found.
